newsitem.title: USA: Capital says judge rules against takeover.
newsitem.headline: Capital says judge rules against takeover.

text.p: Capital Bancorp on Monday said an administrative law judge has ruled that three shareholders who are seeking a controlling interest in the company's Capital Bank unit have not satisfied the statutory criteria for control.
The shareholders -- Fana Holtz, Daniel Holtz and Javier Holtz -- will be filing exceptions with the Florida Comptroller's Office to certain aspects of the judge's findings, Capital Bancorp said.
Capital said the judge's May 16 determination is not a final ruling. The comptroller will render a final ruling after reviewing the judge's findings and the shareholder's exceptions.
Capital Bancorp, based in Miami, has assets of $1.7 billion and deposits totaling $1.1 billion.
